question: Select the most appropriate homonym. He gave her a **cold shoulder** at the party.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ignore**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ignore"** means to deliberately pay no attention to someone or something; to disregard. (नज़रअंदाज़ करना)

 
 
• **Example:** He ignored all the warnings and continued with his plans.
 
 
 
• **"Cold shoulder"** is a phrase that means to intentionally ignore or show disinterest in someone. (जानबूझकर अनदेखा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She felt hurt when he gave her the cold shoulder at the party.
 
 
 
• Hence, the phrase "He gave her a cold shoulder at the party" implies that he ignored her deliberately.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Ignore**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Apology **(माफी): A statement expressing regret for a mistake or wrongdoing.

 
 
• **Example:** He offered a sincere apology for arriving late.
 
 
 
• **Embrace** (गले लगाना): To hold someone closely in one's arms as a gesture of affection.
 
 
• **Example:** They embraced warmly after meeting each other after a long time.
 
 
 
• **Complaint **(शिकायत): A statement expressing dissatisfaction or annoyance.
 
 
• **Example:** She filed a complaint about the noise coming from the neighboring house.
 
 

82:T46c,
The correct answer is** option 3.**
